data.camera: medium shot, side view, face and reaching hand visible
data.description: 【史尔特尔 · 晨光床榻】清晨第一缕阳光洒在凌乱的被单上，史尔特尔裹着薄薄的丝被侧卧在床铺中央，慵懒回眸看着醒来的你。她伸出白皙的手臂拉住你的手腕——「哈啊……天亮得真快。今天罗德岛没有紧急出击任务吧？那就再陪我躺一个小时。」
data.location: 罗德岛·史尔特尔私人舱室
data.promptProse: Surtr lies on her side beneath a thin sheet, reaching for the viewer’s wrist and glancing back; pale morning light crosses the bedding and her shirt cuff.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 晨光床榻
data.animaCaption: She reaches for the viewer's wrist from beneath the thin sheet and glances back from the bed.
